infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: HelpNow needs your location to connect you with nearby helpers in emergencies.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: HelpNow needs background location access to notify you of nearby emergency requests when you're available to help.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HelpNow needs camera access to upload your profile photo and certification documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HelpNow needs photo library access to upload images.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HelpNow needs microphone access for voice messages during emergencies.
